contentPattern.structure: background image + dark overlay + heading + subheading + 1 CTA

suitableFor: background-image banners with overlaid heading and single CTA
notSuitableFor: solid-color banners without a background image (use base banner block)
reuseGuidance.notes: Base 'banner' block was not available in the remote library; this overlay variant was adapted from the site's proven absolute-background-image overlay pattern to match the homepage inverse-section CTA banner.
